notes: ἀμάρτυρον is not a negative indefinite able to carry the English negation alone, so rules 41 and 59 do not empty οὐκ; it keeps not as its own aligned unit and the privative adjective takes without witness headed on witness under rule 84.

The supplied in that rides with ἀγαθουργῶν under rule 86, a participle being exactly the token that carries subordination; the compound heads on did, the ἐργ- core, under rule 66's compound-verb clause, with heading on good named as the competing reading.
All four variants at this verse leave the projection carrying a reading the ASV translates, so no rule 97 note is owed.
